settings.hero_body: If the sculptural lineup caught your eye, look closer at the real collection: eight plush companions with contrasting hoods, ears and colors, made to bring personality to a space.
settings.detail_title: The shapes are soft. The details stand out.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. The hoods and ears give each companion a different silhouette in the group.
settings.final_body: Bring the eight-plush collection into a composition of your own.
settings.moods_title: A study in color and silhouette.
settings.moods_body: Every pictured design is included as a separate plush.
settings.personality_title: From a visual idea to your own shelf.
settings.personality_body: Try a clean lineup or a loose group, letting the contrasting shapes do the work. The paper forms and display architecture in the ad are styling props, not part of the set.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: From a visual idea to your own shelf.
